name: GPI Packaging Catalog
brief: Business Central foundation for Gamer Packaging product catalog and commercial pricing logic
description: Isolated Business Central extension for packaging products, vendor locations, supplier cost history, freight rates, deterministic landed-cost calculations, gross-margin guidance, customer pricing guardrails, saved packaging quote workflows, approval decisions, durable quote audit history, customer-specific historical pricing review, deterministic sourcing comparisons, route-mileage freight fallback, BC Item catalog discovery, controlled sandbox catalog pilot seeding, a demo-oriented packaging product discovery workspace, direct product or landed-cost-to-quote workflow actions, compact commercial quote review, quote-level commercial totals, actionable commercial review status, UOM-aware quote quantity, cost, and proposed-sell normalization, immediate parent quote commercial-review refresh after quote-line edits, query-backed posted-sales history evaluation for responsive guardrail checks, explicit guardrail action feedback, draft-only guardrail evaluation actions, read-only posted Value Entry cost evidence, an in-client historical posted landed-cost evidence view, multi-file packaging product document storage, approved customer-facing packaging quote preview and PDF output, customer-facing specification de-duplication, prepared customer quote email with the approved PDF attached for user review before sending, a BC-side Spiro integration foundation with persistent customer mapping and quote CRM context, and a controlled Business Central opportunity-selection workflow backed by externally refreshed Spiro opportunity cache data. Spiro credentials and outbound Spiro API calls remain outside AL. Internal landed-cost, margin, guardrail, history, approval, and audit fields remain excluded from customer output. This extension is separate from the Zetadocs replacement extension.
